requirements.text: The ATM system shall prevent any account from having a negative balance during transactions.
The ATM system shall automatically withdraw funds from a related savings account when the checking account balance is insufficient.
The ATM system shall inform users when their withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall log all transactions with date, time, type, amount, and resulting balance.
The ATM system shall implement secure PIN verification for user authentication.
The ATM system shall ensure user responsiveness by processing transactions within 3 seconds.
The ATM system shall maintain a transaction throughput of at least 100 transactions per minute.
The ATM system shall optimize data retrieval to minimize latency when accessing transaction history.
The ATM system shall provide immediate feedback if a withdrawal request exceeds available balances.
The ATM system shall provide an option for clients to receive electronic transaction records instead of paper receipts.
The ATM system shall minimize energy consumption by optimizing transaction processing.
The ATM system shall provide transparency by reporting the carbon footprint of each transaction executed.
The ATM system shall implement mechanisms for safe degradation during maintenance.
The ATM system shall maintain user privacy by securely encrypting all personal and financial data.
